extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders, citizens, and organizations wishing to view or submit public comments on Digital Agency proposals (Japan)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and listings for participating in the Digital Agency's public comment (opinion public call) procedure — how to find proposals, applicable legal basis, deadlines, and where results are published. Focused on notice-and-comment for drafts (orders, guidelines, technical standards) under Japanese administrative law.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal basis for public comment
rubrics_metrics.description: Public comments are conducted based on the Administrative Procedure Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states: 'You can check the proposal for opinions through the opinion public call procedure (public comments) based on the Administrative Procedure Act,' indicating the formal statutory basis that governs how opinions are solicited and processed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to check proposals / submission platform
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals for opinions and the public comment procedure are available via e-Gov public comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page directs readers to 'e-Gov public comment' and lists 'Projects for which opinions are being collected' — implying that submissions and viewing of drafts are done through the e-Gov public comment portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application period / deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Each solicitation has a specified application (comment) period with start and end dates that must be observed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples on the page show explicit application periods (e.g., 'From Wednesday, March 18, 2026 to Wednesday, April 8, 2026' and numerous historical date ranges). Timeliness is therefore a procedural requirement for submitting opinions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope/types of documents open to comment
rubrics_metrics.description: Opinions are invited on a wide range of draft materials including draft revisions, draft Orders, Cabinet Orders, Ordinances of the Competent Ministry, Guidelines, Technical Standards, and roadmaps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The itemized list includes many examples: 'draft revision of the "Guidelines for the Procurement and Utilization of generative AI..."', 'draft Order to Partially Amend the Order...', 'Technical Standards for the Implementation of Certification Business', 'Data Governance Guidelines (draft)', 'Education DX Roadmap (draft)'. This indicates the kinds of instruments that are subject to public comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of results / transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Results of public comment periods are announced/published, with a publication date for each item.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page repeatedly lists 'The results of the public comment ... were announced' along with 'Publication Date' or 'Date of publication' entries (e.g., 'Publication Date: April 1, 2026'), indicating that the agency publishes outcomes of the solicitation of opinions and provides a dated record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recordkeeping / archived past solicitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Past public comment solicitations and their results are maintained and listed (archive of prior comment periods and outcomes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page contains an extensive chronological list of past solicitations and their publication dates (covering multiple years), showing that the agency keeps and provides access to historical records of public comment calls and their results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topics may include technical interoperability and standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Public comments are solicited on technical standards and interoperability matters for government information systems and related technical lists (e.g., cipher lists, ISMAP-LIU Cloud Service Registry Rules).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include: 'standards for ensuring the interoperability of terms and symbols used in electronic or magnetic records', 'List of ciphers that should be referenced for procurement in e-government (CRYPTREC Ciphers List)', and 'ISMAP-LIU Cloud Service Registry Rules (Draft)'. This signals that comments may be solicited on detailed technical standards.
